title: Fixed Deep Mast and Twin Wing Hydrofoil Board
description: One newly authored complete static hydrofoil-board-style exterior displayed upside down on its own three broad deck-pad appearances. A whole thick rounded-nose board connects through an underside mount to one full deep tapered mast. The mast meets a long complete longitudinal fuselage carrying one broad swept front wing and an independently complete smaller rear stabilizer wing, with genuine clear air between board, wings and the two separated wing roots. All silhouettes and mesh coordinates newly authored, no old board, aircraft wing or propulsion apparatus imported. Unlike the old windsurf whole rig, this has no above-deck sail, wishbone or foot straps and is not a surfboard with its short rear fin enlarged: the deep mast and two separated transverse wings on one fuselage define the integrated assembly. Unlike the handheld diving device, there is no propeller, motor shell, shroud or handgrip. One whole prop zero scenes, four opaque PBR roles, metres, Z up and complete envelope horizontal centre on finite deck-pad faces. Invented game-art dimensions and blunt closed illustrative wing sections only, not a real hydrodynamic design. No water, rider, buoyancy, lift, stability, propulsion, power, control, speed, strength, fit, mounting compatibility, manufacturing or sport/safety performance. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
